build: Modwerk's linker: Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 + this folder's Quick Trig Conditions 0.2.0-experimental, materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version FC09

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: revision 2ac0f1f; no card; JIT on; DTBOOT_END_PNG at the end of each run

conditions: SETUP: boot FC09 for 11000M with NO pressed eight times from 7000M to close the notices, snapshot; then TRIG, RECORD (GRID RECORDING) and T1, T3 and T5 tapped to place trigs on BD's steps 1, 3 and 5, snapshot. Each capture loads that snapshot and runs the listed --press events for 900M, off the --every grid, with the trig key still held at the end.

captures.plan: T1 held to the end; DOWN, DOWN, UP, UP, then DOWN x5
T3 held to the end; FILL
T5 held to the end; FILL, FILL
